author: GamingBolt
description:
Released in 1997 for PC and MS-DOS before coming to PlayStation One and Game Boy Color, Grand Theft Auto 1's gameplay was fairly fresh for its time: An arcade-esque title with a fixed objective, usually collecting some million(s) of points, and near-limitless freedom to earn them as you saw fit. 

With the story's writing (read: after all the missions were designed, so literally trying to connect the dots as best as possible), it was far from the most compelling tale in the series. Yet, a tale it had, so with Grand Theft Auto 6 on the horizon, let's look back on the story of Grand Theft Auto 1 and Grand Theft Auto 2.
title: Grand Theft Auto 1 and 2  - The Full Story Explained - Before You Play Grand Theft Auto 6

author: GamingBolt
description:
With Phantom Blade Zero doubling down on its wuxia-based inspirations in recent showcases, and previews of the game praising its creative blend of traditional lore and mechanical ingenuity, it can be easy to forget it isn’t the only game that’s bringing the best of the genre to life.

Where Winds Meet has grown from strength to strength this past year, expanding into a wuxia world that’s now far bigger and way more ambitious than the one we began our journey with last year. But can it measure up to the frantic and desperate battles that S-GAME is throwing at it? We’ve taken a look, and it’s been an interesting comparison between these two heavyweights. Join us as we imagine what these two titles crossing blades could be like.
title: Can Phantom Blade Zero Surpass Where Winds Meet’s Wuxia Combat?

author: GamingBolt
description:
It’s back: one of gaming’s most groundbreaking adventures receives a contemporary glow-up, with its time-spanning puzzles, musical interludes, and sprawling dungeons meeting modernised visuals and convenience. 

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is poised to welcome a whole new generation, and we simply can’t wait to explore Hyrule again. Whether it’s your first or your 40th time experiencing Link’s legendary adventure, here are fifteen things to know before you buy.
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
